_comment: Loaded by crew-hub via --settings, so the Telegram plugin is enabled for the HUB SESSION ONLY. Do not enable telegram in ~/.claude/settings.json: the plugin's .mcp.json spawns a bun server in every session that has it, Telegram allows exactly one getUpdates consumer per token, and each new server SIGTERMs whoever holds bot.pid — so any other session silently kills the hub's channel.
_comment_permissions: claude-in-chrome tools pre-approved 2026-09-23 at kaolin's explicit request (Telegram 'yes plz set it'): the telegram plugin relays every permission_request to his phone as a '🔐 Permission… ✅ Allowed' line, and browser automation is dozens of micro-steps per task, so a single ChatGPT-via-Chrome render flooded his chat. Auto-allowing the server suppresses the permission_requests (and thus the relay). Trade-off he accepted: he no longer sees the hub's individual browser steps. Takes effect on the NEXT hub restart.
